SUBJECTIVE:
67-year-old man, day three of a COPD exacerbation. Still breathless on minimal exertion.

OBJECTIVE:
Saturations 91% on 2 litres of oxygen.
Respiratory rate 24.
Afebrile.
Chest exam: scattered wheeze and prolonged expiration.

ASSESSMENT:
COPD exacerbation.

PLAN:
Continue nebulised salbutamol and ipratropium.
Prednisolone 40mg once daily for 5 days.
Oxygen to target 88-92%.
Repeat blood gas this evening.
Physiotherapy review.
Reassess for discharge in 48 hours if improving.
